_comment: Real Unified Social Credit Identifiers, used to prove the transcription of the GB 32100-2015 weights and character set is correct. Codes only - no company names were extracted or stored.

source.issuer: Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China
source.document: 附件6 列名生产企业的具体范围 (Annex 6: scope of listed manufacturers)

why: These codes were issued by Chinese registration authorities, not generated by this package. A single wrong weight or character would drop the pass rate on real codes to roughly 1/31, so a 100% pass here is strong evidence the tables are right.

fullVerification.secondSource: Shanghai Municipal Tax Service, tax-service agency credit score announcement (62 pages), http://shanghai.chinatax.gov.cn/bsfw/zsgl/202110/P020211018521637191708.pdf
fullVerification.note: Only the 55 codes from the two-page Ministry of Finance annex ship with this package, to keep it small. The method is in the README so anyone can repeat the full run.
